comparator.name: Academic Programme in Teaching Pedagogical Sciences
comparator.sourceNotes: The ALPO target is the Radboud Pedagogical Sciences BSc route followed alongside HAN primary-teacher education. The Radboud degree remains 180 EC: students complete 120 EC of adapted Radboud courses over four years and receive 60 EC of exemption on the basis of the parallel Pabo curriculum. The 60-EC exemption is therefore preserved explicitly instead of inventing Radboud courses or treating the combined four-year workload as a single 180-EC programme. Year 3 requires one of four 8-EC specialisations. Education is selected because the generic ALPO target explicitly combines pedagogical science with primary teaching and educational practice; the choice is independent of UCR fit. The current 2026-2027 prospective-student pages establish all Radboud component weights and the exemption structure.
components: Pabo curriculum recognized through the ALPO 60-EC exemption
The Radboud BSc grants 60 EC of exemption because students simultaneously complete the HAN primary-teacher-education curriculum, including school placements and subject didactics.

routeSelection.basis: The generic ALPO target combines pedagogical science with primary teaching and educational practice. Among the four current specialisations, Education most directly represents that defining academic identity through Educational Quality and Curriculum Design. The route was selected without reference to UCR fit.

selection.assessment: The closest match owns the programme's general child-development, pedagogy, learning, teaching and research interests. Orthopedagogy and developmental support remains a coherent and feasible second direction with a materially more clinical and biomedical curriculum. Educational quality and curriculum design is a genuine generator-backed direction, but UCR lacks enough education, didactics and curriculum courses to construct a credible 24-course programme. Production therefore stops at two alternatives.

alternatives.label: Child development, learning & education
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum concentrates child and lifespan development, cognition, language, behaviour, learning, research, social context, ethics and communication, including a course that works directly with primary-school pupils.
alternatives.concept: The closest feasible UCR response combines developmental, cognitive and social psychology with neuroscience, language, physical development, education-facing communication, ethics, sociology and quantitative and qualitative research.
progression: Brain-and-behaviour, sociology, rhetoric, social psychology, research methods, neurobiology and ethics foundations precede advanced cognition, health psychology, developmental psychology, youth resilience, social theory, psycholinguistics and research. The applied rhetoric course follows introductory rhetoric. Every formal prerequisite and planned-semester constraint is satisfied.

alternatives.label: Developmental support, psychology & health
alternatives.labelReason: The curriculum forms an integrated psychological, neuroscientific, biomedical and research pathway focused on developmental difficulties, assessment, mental health, resilience and treatment-related knowledge.
alternatives.concept: A specialist developmental-support direction connecting developmental and abnormal psychology, psychological assessment and intervention, youth resilience and behavioural research with neuroscience, physiology, molecular life science, disease and health.
alternatives.distinctness: Compared with the closest match, this route removes sociology, rhetoric, general research methods, ethics and philosophy of mind and emotion. It adds biomedical and laboratory foundations in cell biology, molecular pathology, pharmacology, infection, immunity and disease mechanisms. Nine of the 24 courses differ, and the organising emphasis shifts from education and learning to specialist developmental and mental-health support.
progression: Brain-and-behaviour and life-science gateways precede every formally dependent psychology, cognition, life-science and biomedical course. Introductory psychology and neurobiology precede advanced developmental, clinical, cognitive and research work. Every course is offered in its assigned term and every formal prerequisite is completed earlier.

blocks: Both address social and emotional processes shaping behaviour and relationships, although UCR's course is general social psychology.
Both examine higher cognitive functions, brain–behaviour relationships and consequences of dysfunction.
Both address perception and action or motor functioning; UCR approaches these processes through cognitive neuroscience rather than a child-development sequence.
Both examine links between cognition and language; UCR provides an advanced psycholinguistic treatment rather than the comparator's developmental course.

Both introduce research design, measurement and statistical reasoning for empirical inquiry.

Both require advanced independent research design, analysis and reporting; UCR's seminar is a course-based research project rather than a separate bachelor thesis.
UCR includes general and psychological statistics, but no separate four-course Analyse sequence corresponding component by component.

UCR does not reproduce the comparator's fourth sequenced analysis course as a separate required component.
Both develop academic argument, writing and oral presentation, while UCR uses rhetoric as its organising framework.
Both develop structured ethical reasoning for difficult professional decisions, though UCR is not specific to Dutch child and education law.

The 60-EC exemption rests on parallel primary-teacher education and school practice. UCR's course is a much smaller but direct counterpart because students design and teach rhetoric activities with primary-school pupils.

notes.text: The ALPO route combines 120 EC of pedagogical-science study at Radboud with a 60-EC exemption grounded in parallel HAN primary-teacher education, including subject didactics, school placements and professional qualification. UCR can combine developmental psychology, cognition, neuroscience, health, sociology, ethics, communication and research, including one course with direct primary-school engagement. It does not provide a teacher-qualification curriculum, school-placement sequence, dedicated education-science core, curriculum-design training or the same orthopedagogical professional pathway.
